name: 02460 · Newtonville, MA
findings: ZIP 02460 (Newtonville) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02460 (Newtonville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
